item.title: Andres O’Neil & Lowe Merges With Montpelier’s Kannel Insurance
item.description: Archbold, OH — December 15, 2025 – Andres O’Neil & Lowe Insurance Agency has announced an upcoming merger with Kannel Insurance of Montpelier, effective January 1, 2026. The partnership brings together two well-established, community-focused agencies in Northwest Ohio. Kannel Insurance, founded in 1958, has served Montpelier and the surrounding area for more than 65 years. item.title: Historic Reflection: 1959 – Montpelier’s Paul Siple
item.description: Noted polar explorer Paul Allman Siple died in Arlington, Virginia. Siple was born in Montpelier on December 18, 1908. When Paul was nine, his family moved to Erie, Pennsylvania. In 1928, as a 19-year-old Boy Scout, Paul was selected to accompany Admiral Richard Byrd on an Antarctic expedition.
